scope: parser validation only; not execution guarantees

register-query.query:
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/>
REGISTER QUERY LowBattery AS
SELECT ?obs ?soc FROM STREAM Telemetry [NOW]
WHERE { STREAM Telemetry { ?obs sosa:hasSimpleResult ?soc } FILTER(?soc < 20) }

from-static.query:
PREFIX sosa: <http://www.w3.org/ns/sosa/>
SELECT ?obs ?soc FROM STREAM Telemetry [NOW]
FROM STATIC <https://example.org/fleet/graph>
WHERE { STREAM Telemetry { ?obs sosa:hasSimpleResult ?soc } FILTER(?soc < 20) }
